claim_rule: A reviewed primitive on one active path does not approve the complete token, key-lifecycle, durable-digest or production security boundary. Every production binary and cryptographic operation must be classified separately.

operations: HMAC-SHA256 verification for the current database-backed access-token path
SHA-256 digest for the current refresh-token credential path
SHA-256 durable spool receipt, failure-reason and deterministic retry-jitter material
constant-time fixed-length access, administrator and durable spool comparison

provider_contracts.required_next_step: Compose an accepted software or remote-key implementation through this boundary without exposing raw key bytes to protocol or persistence handlers.

path_classifications.required_remediation: Replace the static administrator bearer token with an accepted operator identity and authorization profile before production approval.

path_classifications.implementation: OpenSSL SHA-256 and constant-time comparison over byte-stable spool and retry material
path_classifications.required_remediation: Retain byte-stable old/new receipt and retry-jitter regression evidence, then obtain independent data-integrity and security acceptance.

path_classifications.implementation: private SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256, base64url, JSON and equality implementation retained for differential migration
path_classifications.required_remediation: Run old/new/Nakama three-way differential, disable all production features and then remove or retain only a non-shipping fixture with explicit expiry.

production_requirements: Access, refresh, Console, runtime HTTP, socket and authority key domains are separate.
Protocol, domain and persistence handlers receive opaque operations or key references, never production raw key bytes.
Unknown or malformed key epochs never fall back to the legacy route.
Remote provider deadlines and cancellation occur outside mutable database transactions.
Rotation, verification-only grace, emergency revoke and node convergence are rehearsed.
No private hash, MAC, signature, cipher, random or constant-time primitive is reachable from any production binary.
Dependency identity, checksums, license, SBOM, advisories, malformed corpus, fuzzing and independent security decisions are retained.
exit_criteria: CRYPTO-PATH-ACTIVE-ACCESS-AUTH is composed through the opaque provider contract.
CRYPTO-PATH-ACTIVE-ADMIN-AUTH uses an accepted operator identity and authorization profile.
CRYPTO-PATH-ACTIVE-OUTBOX-DIGEST has byte-stable old/new regression evidence and independent acceptance.
The compatibility reference is non-shipping or removed after accepted three-way differential evidence.
Production KMS, HSM or approved secret-manager profiles pass rotation, revoke, permission, timeout, cancellation and audit tests.
Independent cryptography and application-security reviewers accept the exact source, dependency and evidence objects.
